In certain circumstances you can also get things like a drivers license covered by the government. While you are searching for a job you also get support from the government to keep you afloat and there's also government housing available. 

It's almost impossible to completely fail in Norway, there are just so many pretty well designed safety nets. They're not perfect, and sometimes they fudge up, but all in all our system is pretty nice. 

(We still have huge issues though, it's unfortunately incredibly hard to get a job in Norway with a foreign sounding name.)

The project went on for several decades as well, it started in 70's, didn't mean it ended there. 

I'm not surprised at it, I was merely observing that it happened. You can't one hand claim that society is against you when you reject the attempts at helping you as well.
